narrative.intro: Northrop Grumman Systems obligated $2.9B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Northrop Grumman Systems secured two awards so far, with an average award size of $1.4B and obligations up 124.5% year over year. Northrop Grumman Systems has shifted its FY obligations over the last six years, with FY21 at $1.1B, FY22 at $2B, FY23 at $2.9B, FY24 at $3.5B, FY25 at $1.3B, and FY26 at $2.9B. Northrop Grumman Systems concentrates FY2026 obligations in Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing at $2.9B. Northrop Grumman Systems also recorded obligations in Engineering Services at $1.7M. This profile shows a heavy tilt toward missile and space vehicle manufacturing in the current fiscal year, with a much smaller engineering services footprint reported to date. Use these figures to benchmark competition, plan teaming, or scope capture work where missile and space vehicle manufacturing is the primary procurement area for Northrop Grumman Systems in FY2026 to date.
